content:
morgan: Heads-up: small night-drop to push 1.5.0-rc.1 for py + ts. Will publish a short-lived dist-tag for partner testing. Rolling in ~25m unless objections.
devon: fine with me. which tag name so CI can pin?
tara: propose `partners-rc-2026-03-21` to be explicit. I'll prep the CHANGELOG + npm `deprecated` field for the sync package.
ishaan: rollback rules: immediate yank if deploy-bot reports `signer-mismatch` or npm returns 403; runtime revert if 5xx > 0.6% in first 5m or median SDK latency +200ms.
morgan: plan:
1) build wheels -> testpypi (no-clean)
2) npm pack + publish with `--tag partners-rc-2026-03-21`
3) set pip alias and pack checksum in release notes
4) run smoke + perf harness
If any packaging/auth flake, we'll hold the tag.
deploy-bot: [483330-483331] publish job started: py(jb_48333) / npm(nb_48333) :rocket:
devon: reminder: lock monorepo `package.json` to the rc to avoid prow auto-upgrades. e.g. `"@redwood/sdk": "1.5.0-rc.1"`
tara: added deprecation text: "The legacy sync client (`@redwood/sdk-sync`) is deprecated and scheduled for removal. Please migrate to the async client or unified SDK. Migration guide: https://redwood.ai/migrate-sync. Removal window: 90 days."
ops-bot: note: security signoff required for key override if signer fails.
deploy-bot: [483331-483332] py -> testpypi (jb_48333) SUCCESS. checksum: 789abc...
morgan: launching npm publish now.
deploy-bot: [483332-483333] npm publish (nb_48333) FAILED: checksum/integrity mismatch writing tarball. log: `EINTEGRITY: unexpected hash for package`
ishaan: saw that before when node version changed packaging order. samir had fixed by pinning node for pack. we should pin node in CI pack step to 18.
devon: for quick unblock, can we repack locally and re-trigger?
morgan: yes, repacking with node:18 in container. Also adding a `pack-check` job to assert tar SHA before publish.
deploy-bot: [483333-483334] npm publish restarted (nb_48333) -> SUCCESS. dist-tag set -> partners-rc-2026-03-21
ara (tara): running pinned e2e + smoke against canary gateway. prow tests pinned to rc now.
deploy-bot: [483334-483335] smoke-suite started (is_48333)
ishaan: monitoring metrics: first 4m show 0.08% 5xx, median latency +15ms, all within SLOs.
morgan: marketing snippet request: short technical blurb including migration link and removal window.
tara: draft: "Developer preview: 1.5.0-rc.1 available to partners under dist-tag `partners-rc-2026-03-21`. Legacy sync client `@redwood/sdk-sync` deprecated; see migration guide. Scheduled removal in 90 days."
devon: add npm `package.json` deprecated field before we advertise: 
```json
"deprecated": "Deprecated: see https://redwood.ai/migrate-sync"
```
morgan: good. We'll keep the dist-tag for 48h for partner validation, then promote to `canary` if no regressions. Add ticket to release board to remove deprecated pkg page in 90d.
deploy-bot: [483335-4833312500] smoke-suite COMPLETE: PASS (is_48333). No signer/auth issues.
ishaan: follow-ups: 1) pin node 18 in pack pipeline 2) add pack checksum assertion 3) add automatic dist-tag cleanup job after TTL 48h
morgan: capturing in release checklist and closing this thread. summary: RC published -> partners-rc-2026-03-21, initial pack integrity fail fixed by node pin, smoke/perf within thresholds, dist-tag held 48h for partner testing. Thanks :thumbsup:
